notationConventions.raw: 4/4 with four quarter-note cells per measure; | marks midpoint division (not new measure).
notationConventions.playbackInterpretation: Note positions are derived from printed tonic-solfa cells. Some dotted notes and organ passages require expert verification.

limitations: Independent organ/refrain entrances on page 1 are not fully represented in the four SATB rows.
Unclear octave marks and chromatic degrees on the scan need comparison with a clearer edition.
The source includes dynamics and an organ overlap; a single linear note stream does not implement the overlap.
The scan has no numerical BPM.

dataContract.sourceOfTruth: measures[].voices[voice].notes with raw source notation preserved

transcriptionStatus.notes: Original printed note cells regrouped; no printed BPM specified. Not certified note-perfect.

noteRegeneration.source: displayRaw (as edited by the user, unchanged)
noteRegeneration.method: token-based SATB note rebuild; each : or | is a rhythmic-cell boundary; MIDI pitches mapped from do and octave marks; rhythmic dots and holds interpreted
noteRegeneration.timeBase: absolute (full-bar source coordinates, corrected for pickups by app timing module)
noteRegeneration.attention: 3/4/4/4/6/8 meters and fine dotted/subdivided figures were interpreted from existing JSON; the printed score may require further manual timing validation.
